historical_references.reference: Futah is also the name of an important city in the early Islamic period, located in present-day Iraq. It was the capital city of the Rashidun Caliphate under the rule of Caliph Ali ibn Abi Talib from 651 to 661 AD. During this time, Futah served as a center of Islamic learning and culture, with many scholars and poets residing there.
